title: Taylor Sheridan, Yellowstone, and the Last American Myth

sentences.en: In 1870, a 19-year-old named Samuel Burke Burnett bought 100 head of cattle, wearing the brand 6-6-6, wait for it, 6.
sentences.zh: 1870年，一位名叫塞缪尔·伯克·伯内特的19岁青年买了100头牛，这些牛身上打的烙印是6-6-6，等等，还有个6。

sentences.en: And the legend says that he won the ranch with four sixes in a poker game, but that's not true.
sentences.zh: 传说他是在一场扑克牌局中靠四个6赢得了这个牧场，但这并非事实。

sentences.en: And the fact that everyone repeats it anyway tells you the ranch was in the business of myth before it was in the business of cattle, like most of the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 然而，即便每个人都在重复这个故事，也足以说明这个牧场在经营牛群之前，就已经在经营神话了，就像美国西部的大多数地方一样。

sentences.en: And Burnett built an empire on grass, and a good deal of that grass belonged to the Comanche.
sentences.zh: 伯内特靠着草场建立了一个帝国，而其中很大一部分草场原本属于科曼奇人。

sentences.en: And to understand how a Texas cattleman ended up grazing his herds on a Comanche reservation, you have to know who Quanah Parker was.
sentences.zh: 要理解一位德克萨斯牧牛人是如何在科曼奇保留地上放牧的，你必须了解夸纳·帕克是谁。

sentences.en: In 1836, Comanche raiders hit Fort Parker in East Texas and carried off a nine-year-old girl named Cynthia Ann Parker.
sentences.zh: 1836年，科曼奇突袭队袭击了东德克萨斯的帕克堡，掳走了一名九岁的女孩，名叫辛西娅·安·帕克。

sentences.en: She grew up a Comanche, married the war leader, Peta Nakona, and had children.
sentences.zh: 她在科曼奇族中长大，嫁给了战争领袖佩塔·纳科纳，并育有子女。

sentences.en: And when Texas Rangers recaptured her in 1860, she never adjusted to white life again, and she tried to go back to the Indians.
sentences.zh: 1860年，当德克萨斯骑警将她夺回时，她再也没能适应白人的生活，并试图回到印第安人身边。

sentences.en: Her story is the loose source for the movie The Searchers,
sentences.zh: 她的故事是电影《搜索者》的松散素材来源，

sentences.en: John Ford's 1956 western, one of the most famous films ever made about a white family's obsession with a captive who doesn't want to be rescued.
sentences.zh: 那是约翰·福特1956年执导的西部片，也是关于一个白人家庭对一个不愿被营救的被俘者产生执念的最著名电影之一。

sentences.en: Her son was Quanah, and he grew up to lead the Quadi, the hardest holdout Comanche band.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子是夸纳，他长大后领导了夸迪，这是科曼奇族中最顽固的抵抗派系。

sentences.en: He fought the Buffalo Hunters at Adobe Walls in 1874, and in 1875, he became the last Comanche leader to bring his people onto the reservation at Fort Sill.
sentences.zh: 1874年，他在阿多比墙之战中对抗水牛猎人，并于1875年成为最后一位带领族人进入锡尔堡保留地的科曼奇领袖。

sentences.en: What Quanah did next is why he belongs in an episode about Taylor Sheridan's movie and TV show universe centered around his hit Yellowstone.
sentences.zh: 夸纳接下来的所作所为，正是他为何会出现在这一集关于泰勒·谢里丹的电影和电视宇宙（以其热门剧集《黄石》为中心）中的原因。

sentences.en: He became the most successful businessman on the reservation.
sentences.zh: 他成为了保留地上最成功的商人。

sentences.en: The Comanche and the Kiowa land in southwest Oklahoma was prime grass with no cattle on it, and Texas cattlemen, like Burke Burnett, wanted it,
